evals.name: overworld-snes-soundmd
evals.prompt: I'm working on my game Emberfall, the project folder is {project}. I need the overworld theme: heroic and adventurous, SNES style, think Secret of Mana / Zelda field music. It has to loop seamlessly. Put it wherever the SOUND.md says music goes.
evals.expected_output: A SNES-style (snes) looping overworld theme that respects SOUND.md: palette without the Avoid instruments, tempo within 80-140, exported to assets/audio/music/overworld.ogg (+ loop json) at -18 LUFS, seamless, with an Audio Log row appended and the style sections untouched.
expectations: Exported to assets/audio/music/overworld.ogg (SOUND.md's path) with loop json next to it
A song.json was delivered and uses the 'snes' console style
song.json is a loop ("loop": true or {"from": ...})
The song builds with 0 harmony / spec problems
The loop has at least two contrasting parts (two or more different progressions)
The last bar leads back into the loop (its final chord differs from the loop's first chord)
make's loop json reports the seam SEAMLESS
Independent check of the loop file: sample-continuous wrap and exact bar length (±5 ms)
Loop loudness is -18.0 LUFS ±1
True peak of the loop is at or below -1 dBFS
A preview mp3 and the reply (response.md) were delivered
Instruments respect SOUND.md's Avoid line (no synth / FM leads, distorted guitar, electric or synth bass, drum machine)
Tempo is inside SOUND.md's 80-140 BPM range
Exploration theme in a major key, as SOUND.md asks (loop starts on a major chord)
SOUND.md's Audio Log got a new row for overworld.ogg
SOUND.md's style sections (everything above the Audio Log) were left unchanged

evals.name: boss-fm-intro
evals.prompt: Make me a boss fight track for my shmup. Genesis-style FM, fast and aggressive. It should have a short intro that plays once and then loop forever. I'll drop it into Godot.
evals.expected_output: An fm-style boss loop at a fast tempo with a short play-once intro (loop.from), exported as intro / loop / full OGG files with correct LOOPSTART/LOOPLENGTH tags, seamless, -16 LUFS, and Godot instructions in the reply.
expectations: A song.json was delivered and uses the 'fm' console style
song.json is a loop ("loop": true or {"from": ...})
The song builds with 0 harmony / spec problems
The loop has at least two contrasting parts (two or more different progressions)
The last bar leads back into the loop (its final chord differs from the loop's first chord)
make's loop json reports the seam SEAMLESS
Independent check of the loop file: sample-continuous wrap and exact bar length (±5 ms)
Loop loudness is -16.0 LUFS ±1
True peak of the loop is at or below -1 dBFS
A preview mp3 and the reply (response.md) were delivered
Has a short play-once intro (loop.from set, 1-8 intro bars)
Fast tempo for a boss fight (>= 140 BPM)
Aggressive / dark harmony (loop starts on a minor or power chord)
Delivers the intro, loop and full (tagged) OGG files
full.ogg's LOOPSTART / LOOPLENGTH tags match the loop json and the file length
The reply tells the user how to loop it in Godot (Loop import flag or loop_offset)

evals.name: dungeon-underplay-1min
evals.prompt: I need a tense 16-bit dungeon loop for my dark dungeon crawler, around a minute long. It plays under combat sound effects, so it shouldn't be too busy.
evals.expected_output: A minor-key, restrained dungeon loop of about 60 s (50-70 s) at a slow-to-moderate tempo, sparse drums and accompaniment, seamless, -16 LUFS.
expectations: A song.json was delivered and uses the 'snes' or 'fm' console style
song.json is a loop ("loop": true or {"from": ...})
The song builds with 0 harmony / spec problems
The loop has at least two contrasting parts (two or more different progressions)
The last bar leads back into the loop (its final chord differs from the loop's first chord)
make's loop json reports the seam SEAMLESS
Independent check of the loop file: sample-continuous wrap and exact bar length (±5 ms)
Loop loudness is -16.0 LUFS ±1
True peak of the loop is at or below -1 dBFS
A preview mp3 and the reply (response.md) were delivered
Loop is about a minute (50-70 s)
Slow-to-moderate dungeon tempo (<= 110 BPM)
Tense / dark harmony (loop starts on a minor, power or sus chord)
Arrangement stays out of the way of combat SFX (no battle / boss / rock drums, no 8th-note stabs)
